```{r}
#| label: fig-mpg
#| fig-cap:  "Title"

#loading Librarys
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

my_data <- read_csv("../data/stx_fish_psu.csv")

ggplot(my_data,
       aes (x = YEAR, y = density))+
  geom_point()

```

```{r}
#| label: fig-mpg2
#| fig-cap:  "Title"

#loading Librarys
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

my_data <- read_csv("../data/stx_fish_psu.csv")

my_data |> 
  group_by(YEAR) |>  
  summarise(density = mean(density, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  kable()
```
